Welcome to IPSB School of Integrative Psycho-Structural Bodywork.
We are the leading school of holistic massage & bodywork training in Los Angeles and have been training students for over 35 years. 

Come experience our personal and compassionate program which includes a unique focus on Tai Chi as the foundation of all movements. Grounded in the body-mind-heart  connection, we create a unique learning environment that encourages self-discovery and equips our students with the tools they need to have above average career longevity and job satisfaction. This well-rounded approach focuses on the whole person, recognizing that touching the body touches the soul.
